name: YOUR WANDERLAND
source:
Astrea Games' first project and visual novel. YOUR WANDERLAND is a psychological horror game where the supernatural meets the ordinary and truths untold to time itself resurface.

Stepping into the shoes of a boy whose identity is unknown even to himself, piece together your own past and the memories of a piece of world that has been forgotten.
translation:
Astrea Games推出的首部企划暨视觉小说作品。《YOUR WANDERLAND》是一款心理恐怖游戏，在这里，超自然异象与平淡日常悄然交汇，连岁月本身都未曾知晓的秘辛再度浮出水面。

你将化身为一名连自己真实身份都无从知晓的少年，一步步拼凑出属于自己的过往，以及某片早已被遗忘的世界残片记忆。
